categories.main_business_segments: Tianqi Lithium Corporation primarily operates in the lithium industry, focusing on upstream lithium resource development, midstream lithium concentrate production and sales, and downstream lithium chemical products manufacturing and sales. The company’s product portfolio includes lithium concentrates (chemical-grade and technical-grade) and lithium chemical products such as battery-grade lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, lithium metal, and lithium chloride. It serves multiple end markets including electric vehicles, consumer electronics, energy storage, glass, and ceramics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced open-pit mining techniques for lithium extraction, particularly at its Greenbushes lithium mine in Australia. Lithium concentrate production involves multi-stage crushing, gravity separation, regrinding, magnetic separation, flotation, thickening, and filtration. Lithium chemical products are produced through processes including roasting, acid leaching, purification, evaporation, crystallization, and electrolysis for lithium metal. The company emphasizes quality control with ISO9001 and IATF16949 certifications and invests in R&D for new lithium extraction and processing technologies, including solid-state battery materials and lithium recycling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianqi Lithium’s key customers include global lithium-ion battery manufacturers, battery material producers, new energy vehicle companies, multinational electronics firms, and glass and ceramics manufacturers. The company has established long-term strategic partnerships with leading players in the electric vehicle and battery supply chains worldwide. Its products are widely used in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant assets and operations in China, Australia, and Chile. Key lithium mining assets are located in Australia (Greenbushes mine) and China (Sichuan province). It holds equity stakes in Chilean lithium salt lake projects (SQM and Zhabuye). Production facilities for lithium chemical products are located in China (Sichuan, Jiangsu, Chongqing) and Australia. The company’s sales and customer base span China, Japan, South Korea, Europe, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianqi Lithium operates across the lithium supply chain, with a vertically integrated model covering upstream lithium mining (hard rock and salt lake resources), midstream lithium concentrate production, and downstream lithium chemical product manufacturing. It also engages in strategic investments and partnerships in battery materials, solid-state batteries, and electric vehicles, extending its presence into downstream applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes consolidating upstream lithium resource control, expanding lithium chemical product capacity, and deepening integration along the lithium value chain. R&D priorities encompass lithium resource comprehensive utilization, new lithium extraction technologies, next-generation high-performance lithium battery materials, battery recycling, and solid-state battery materials. It actively collaborates with universities and research institutes to drive innovation and enhance sustainable, low-carbon lithium production technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Tianqi Lithium generates revenue primarily through the sale of lithium concentrates and lithium chemical products. Sales are conducted via direct sales and long-term strategic contracts with major battery manufacturers and industrial customers. The company also earns investment income from equity stakes in lithium resource projects and related enterprises. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of products to customers, typically at delivery or shipment points.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianqi Lithium is positioned as a global leader in the lithium industry, controlling one of the world’s largest and highest-grade hard rock lithium mines (Greenbushes) and holding significant stakes in major salt lake lithium projects. Its main competitors include Albemarle Corporation, SQM, and other large lithium producers. The company leverages its integrated supply chain, resource quality, and technological capabilities to maintain competitive advantages in cost and product quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianqi Lithium reported total revenue of approximately RMB 13.06 billion, a significant decline of 67.75% compared to the previous year, primarily due to falling lithium prices. The company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.9 billion. Total assets stood at RMB 68.68 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 41.89 billion. Despite short-term volatility and losses, the company maintains substantial scale and is investing in capacity expansion and R&D to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianqi Lithium emphasizes its vertically integrated supply chain, combining high-quality lithium resources with advanced processing technologies to provide stable, high-purity lithium products. Its Greenbushes mine offers a low-cost, high-grade lithium concentrate supply, supporting competitive pricing and product reliability. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality management, and sustainability, along with strategic partnerships across the lithium battery value chain, differentiates it as a trusted supplier for leading global battery and electric vehicle manufacturers.
